title: Credit Office Standard — Amount of a Credit Refund, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Standard.** The credit refund on the Patient Financial Account is the account's credit balance once the credit has been applied to every other open charge: every payment, time-of-service collection and adjustment posted to the account, less every charge, reversed payment and refund, refunded in full, never below 0.00, and rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## The credit balance, line by line

| Raises the credit | Lowers the credit |
|---|---|
| every payment posted | every charge posted |
| every time-of-service collection | every reversed payment |
| every adjustment | every refund already issued |

A result of 0.00 or less means there is no credit to refund.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| payments posted | 980.00 |
| time-of-service collections | 60.00 |
| adjustments | 214.50 |
| charges posted | 1,020.00 |
| reversed payments | 0.00 |
| refunds already issued | 50.00 |
| credit balance: 980.00 plus 60.00 plus 214.50, less 1,020.00, 0.00 and 50.00 | 184.50 |
| credit refund, in full | 184.50 |

With charges of 1,300.00 instead, the same entries would leave nothing to refund, and the credit refund would be 0.00.
